translation.name: Dillꞌ wen dillꞌ   Kob C̱he   Jesucrístonaꞌ

content: Nad' ngoo lall' na' bish' ljwellchoki nonḻilall' Crístona', chzej' li', Gayo, nako' beṉ' chakid' do yic̱hj do lallaa.
Beṉ' bish'dawaa, chṉabid' Chioza' kon ka mbalaz nak yic̱hjlall'do'na' lawe'na', ka'kz gak wen c̱ho' lao yog'ḻoḻte na' so' shi'a shao'.
Ḻe biba bizakid' ka bid baḻ beṉ' bish'choka' na' wnagake' zoac̱hec̱ho' lo nez ḻi c̱he Chioza'.
Bich bi de dii chonan ka yiba yizakchid' ka daa iṉezid' nan beṉ'ka' nak ka xiiṉ' zejgake' lo nez ḻi c̱he Chioza'.
Beṉ' bish'dawaa, ḻe wen chono' daa chakleno' bish' ljwellchoka' chon xshin Crístona', ḻa'kzi nakgake' beṉ' zit' beṉ' bi nombi'o.

Lao beṉ'ki lle' ni nonḻilall'lenchogake' Crístona' ba be'gake' xtilloo daa ḻe chakilo' ḻegake'. Ben goklen, be'gake' daa chyallj chc̱hingakile' kon ka chaklall' Chioza' goncho, kwenc̱he koochgake' nez.
Ḻa' ḻegake' ba wloogake' nez kwenc̱he gongake' xshin Jesucrístona', na' bibi bex̱'gake' c̱he beṉ'ka' bi nonḻilall'gake'ne'.
Daan, chiyaḻ' we'cho daa chyallj chc̱hingakile' kwenc̱he gaklenchogake' we'gake' dill' ḻi c̱he Chioza'.
Ba bzej' le', le' chdop chllagle choe'la'ole Crístona', per Diótrefeza' bi chzenague' daa nia' le' daa cheenile' toze' iṉabi'e.

Na' daan shi ba gokan yid' gana' zoale na' wsheshlenee, ḻa' chde' biz chon chne' c̱ha'. Na' leyi bi chlebe' bish' ljwellchoka' chla' gana' lle'le. Na' beṉ'ka' cheeni wleb ḻegake', chsej chllone', na' chibeje' ḻegake' bich cho'e latj idop illaglengake' le' txen.
Li' bish'dawaa, bi ḻeno' gono' dii mala', san ben daa nak wen. Beena' chon daa nak wen nake' Chioza' txen, san beena' chon dii mala' biṉ' gombi'e Chiozan'.
Yog'zə beṉ' choe' xtill' Demétriona' daa chone' wen, na' nakbia'cha chzenague' dill' ḻi c̱he Chioza'. Na' ḻekzka' neto' choe'nto' dill' ka wen chone', na' ṉezkzilo' dill' ḻin choe'nto'.
Na' dii zan dii cheenid' iṉia' li', per bi cheenid' gona'n yishzə,
ḻa' chbez' yob gat' latj yidkz' gana' zo' kwenc̱he ile'i ljwellcho na' we'cho dill'.
Chioza' gone' ka soashgo' mbalaz. Beṉ'ki nllaguicho chwapgake' li' chiox. Bwapgach chiox to to beṉ'ka' nllaguicho gana' zo'.
